description: This file defines a class ExportService that provides methods for exporting journal entries to TXT and PDF formats, including logging, directory management, and integration with a database module for user info.

classes.name: ExportService
classes.description: Service for exporting journal entries in TXT and PDF formats, with methods to perform exports, format dates, and clean up old export files.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the export directory and ensures it exists.

methods.name: str export_to_txt(self, user_id: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], filename: str = None)
methods.description: Exports journal entries to a text file with headers and entry details.

methods.name: str export_to_pdf(self, user_id: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], filename: str = None)
methods.description: Exports journal entries to a PDF file with styled headers, entries, and user info.

methods.name: str _format_date(self, date_str: str)
methods.description: Converts ISO date strings into a readable format.

methods.name: cleanup_old_exports(self, days_old: int = 7)
methods.description: Removes export files older than a specified number of days.

ctags.signature: (self, user_id: str, entries: List[Dict[str, Any]], filename: str = None)
